plugin.name: Hongguo Short Drama
plugin.description: Launch and manage the Hongguo short-drama player inside Youth: one-click playback, AI chat control, cache and data management.
view.console.label: Hongguo Drama
view.console.description: Hongguo player: start/stop, cache & data management
tool.launch.label: Open Hongguo player
tool.stop.label: Close Hongguo player
tool.status.label: Hongguo running state
tool.clean.label: Clean Hongguo cache
tool.openData.label: Open Hongguo data folder
panel.cacheCleaned: Cache cleaned (login, favorites and history untouched)
panel.deepConfirmBody: This deletes all local Hongguo data: signs you out, clears favorites and watch history, resets settings. This cannot be undone. Other files on disk are unaffected.
panel.noteDeps: On first launch the player auto-installs WebView2 runtime / HEVC extensions if missing (requires internet); otherwise it falls back to software decoding (higher CPU).
panel.noteAntivirus: The player is unsigned and may trigger antivirus false positives: add the plugin install folder to your whitelist; allow it through the firewall if local playback fails.
panel.disclaimer: The Hongguo player is an unofficial third-party client for personal study use. This plugin only integrates launching and management; it is not affiliated with Hongguo.
panel.cmdPermissionHint: If the error mentions permissions, enable the process and filesystem permissions in Settings → Plugins → Hongguo and retry.
panel.preparing: First run downloads the player (~27 MB)…
panel.updateAvailable: New version v{{version}} available — click Open to update
panel.heroTagline: A local short-drama player managed by Youth in one click
panel.dataDirHint: Data directory %APPDATA%/hgplayer (uninstalling the plugin keeps player data)
panel.note1: On first launch the player auto-installs WebView2 runtime / HEVC extensions if missing (requires internet); otherwise it falls back to software decoding (higher CPU).
panel.note2: The player is unsigned and may trigger antivirus false positives: add the plugin install folder to your whitelist; allow it through the firewall if local playback fails.
panel.note3: The player binary is fully managed by the plugin: downloaded on demand from the official release (served via Youth R2), and new versions are picked up automatically.
panel.note4: The Hongguo player is an unofficial third-party client for personal study use. This plugin only integrates launching and management; it is not affiliated with Hongguo.
